audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[0..6] read Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Katarina, Aurora, Aurora — which is exactly packet.levelChart. The full layer was stale and the page rendered two different answers per row.
audit.why: The content chart and the packet already agree and the kit supports them: Katarina's whole kit is 625 (Bouncing Blade) to 725 (Shunpo) against Aurora's 900 Q and 825 E, so levels 1-5 are Aurora's. Level 6 is Katarina's the moment Death Lotus exists, because it also applies Grievous Wounds to Aurora's passive spirit healing. Aurora's first item retakes the lane against a 75-second ultimate Katarina cannot shorten without a kill. Difficulty TRICKY 7/10 at a 48.33% win rate over 1794 games stands.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side = Aurora, phases[4].side = Katarina, phases[5..6].side = Aurora, ratings 6/6/6/6/4/6/6, each affected why rewritten in the same proposal. content win[] needed no edit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike ladder had no numbers and spikes[2] named Riftmaker or Shadowflame while report[8] prescribes Luden's into Sorcerer's. whys[4] attributed the reset mechanic to the ultimate ('Her ultimate resets and burst').
audit.why: Resets come from Voracity, the passive: 'Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.' Death Lotus is 75/60/45 at 550 range. Bouncing Blade is 11s at rank 1 falling to 7s. Shunpo is 12s to 8s.
audit.corrected: Spikes rebuilt on the real ladder: nothing at 1-5 she can reach you with, the 75-second Death Lotus at 6, first item retaking the lane, and Voracity as the mechanic that makes one kill compound. spikes[2] regrounded on 'your first item' rather than picking a side of the item contradiction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent from every field: Death Lotus is a channel, and Aurora's Between Worlds shockwave is hard CC, so her R cancels his — hers — mid-channel. Also absent: Death Lotus applies Grievous Wounds against Aurora's passive healing, Shunpo blinks to Katarina's own daggers, and Katarina pays no mana for anything. Aurora's E was again called a 'knockback-slow'.
audit.why: enemyKit R flags: channel ('interruptible — any CC cancels it') and antiHeal, text 'while she channels'. ownerKit R flags: hardCC, plus a slow zone at 250 cast range against Death Lotus's 550. enemyKit E: 'blinks to the target' at 725, and Bouncing Blade leaves a dagger on the ground for her to blink to. Every Katarina ability in the kit has cost 0. ownerKit E: damage and slow, then Aurora hops backward — no knockback.
audit.corrected: The counter-ult is now the headline of the page (tldr, winCon, loading, breakdown.late, report[5], spikes[3], late). Grievous Wounds on your spirit healing is stated at the level-6 row. Dagger-blinking drives the trade and don't advice. Zero mana cost is stated so nobody tries to starve her. E restated correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (catalogue defect 3) — it was the Shunpo blurb pasted twice with 'Count it out loud if you must'.
audit.why: Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8, Bouncing Blade 11/10/9/8/7, Death Lotus 75/60/45, all at zero mana.
audit.corrected: All three numbers now appear, with the hard-CC-ends-the-channel note attached to Death Lotus.

audit.whatIsWrong: Katarina was called he/his in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, loading, breakdown.wave, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[2].t, phases[0].why, phases[5].why and four report entries.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists katarina as female. The owner is 'you', so every third-person pronoun on the page is Katarina.
audit.corrected: Fixed, and the sentences regrounded in her kit rather than pronoun-swapped in place.

audit.whatIsWrong: content early asserted 'Shunpo needs a dagger already in range'. That is false and it changes how a reader spaces.
audit.why: enemyKit E: 'Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise' at 725 range. She can Shunpo straight onto you; the dagger only makes it better.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the real numbers: Shunpo blinks 725 and Bouncing Blade reaches 625, both short of your 900.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two derived flags on the enemy kit are tooltip-parsing misfires and I did not write either to the page.
audit.why: Bouncing Blade carries a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's text is 'throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground' — the word 'ground' is the parse, not a grounding effect. Preparation carries a 'knockup' flag, but its text is 'gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself' — the dagger goes up, nothing is displaced. The brief instructs that Riot's description wins over a contradicting flag.
audit.corrected: Neither claim written. Notably, if the grounding flag were real it would deny Aurora's W and R dashes, so it is worth the entry.

notes: Full-layer chart was 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] already matched packet.levelChart exactly — flipped the seven sides plus ratings and rewrote every affected why in the same proposal; no content win[] edit was needed. The decisive interaction was entirely absent from the page: Death Lotus is a channel and Aurora's R shockwave carries hardCC, so Between Worlds cancels it, and Death Lotus in turn applies Grievous Wounds to Aurora's passive spirit healing. Both came from missingInteractions and both are now on the page. Also newly stated: Shunpo blinks 725 to Katarina's own daggers, and no Katarina ability costs mana (every cost field is 0), which kills the instinct to try to starve her. Two derived flags on the Katarina kit are misfires and were NOT written: Bouncing Blade's 'grounding' (Riot's text just says the dagger ricochets onto the ground) and Preparation's 'knockup' (she tosses a dagger into the air above herself). The grounding one matters — if it were real it would deny Aurora's W and R dashes. content early asserted 'Shunpo needs a dagger already in range', which is false per Riot's text, and it was driving the spacing advice; corrected. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit. Twelve misgendered fields fixed. spikes[2] named Riftmaker/Shadowflame against report[8]'s Luden's line; I regrounded on 'your first item' rather than pick a side. As with the other Aurora matchups, 'Twin Drift' and 'The Weirding' appear on the page as Aurora ability names and packet.suspectNames flags the latter; the kit file carries no ability names for Aurora, so I could not verify either and avoided both in the rewrites.
